title: Can You Fool AI by Doing a 180? – A Case Study on Authorship Analysis of Texts by Arata Osada
reasoning: The paper investigates how a major shift in an author's ethical values and political opinions (specifically moving from militarism to pacifism) impacts the ability of AI models like BERT to perform authorship verification. It explicitly analyzes 'core moral values' and 'personal ethics' as variables in text analysis.
